title: Signature 01 · Glamour Hourglass · Najeon · Bamboo Dawn
prompt:
Subject: ONE Black woman in her mid 30s, sleek center-parted low bun with a mother-of-pearl binyeo.

Physique: THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH, blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, not brown, her face the same deep tone with natural highlights and clearly defined features, not flat. Glamour hourglass bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an overwhelmingly enormous full bust, a waist cinched so impossibly tiny it is barely a third of the width of her hips, hips flaring to nearly twice the width of her shoulders, thighs thicker than her waist pressing together, soft full voluptuous curves everywhere. Not skinny, not a runway model, dominating the frame.

Body Art: Full body najeon-chilgi painted directly on bare skin, covering every inch from neck to ankle without exception. Deep glossy black lacquer densely inlaid with thick cut mother-of-pearl shell pieces with visible sharp cut edges, flashing pink, green, and blue iridescent sheen, not painted, real inlaid shell. Large peony blossoms and continuous vines spread wide across the bust and hips and narrow across the tiny waistline. Densely filled with no plain skin, covering the shoulders and arms completely down to the wrists and the legs down to the ankles.

Pose: Standing in a wide stance with a strong hip shift, one hand resting lightly on her outer thigh, the other arm hanging relaxed away from the body.

Footwear: Extremely high black lacquer platform stiletto mules with mother-of-pearl studs. Nails: extra long stiletto, black with pearl tips.

Background & Lighting: A pale misty bamboo grove at dawn, soft white light filtering through tall green stalks, the background much lighter than her body, low sunlight carving the impossibly tiny waist, making every shell piece flash rainbow, bright highlights on every glossy curve. Extreme high-gloss lacquer finish. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
